result.title: One Fact, Many Places: Redundant Evidence in Long Visual Documents Breaks Single-Gold Evaluation of Retrieval, Citation and Attribution
result.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures; includes supplementary material. Code, data and editable figure sources provided as ancillary files
result.summary: Document understanding is increasingly judged on where an answer comes from, scored against annotated gold locations as if each fact lived in one place. In long visual documents, a fact often lives in several places: a chart value is restated in the text, a key figure reappears in the summary. We ask how often such copies occur in standard benchmarks and what they do to evaluation. We annotate 420 questions from MMLongBench-Doc and MMDocRAG with the locations that independently establish each required fact, checked by two independent reviewers. Copies are common and often cross-modal: 19.5% of MMLongBench-Doc test questions have a strict copy outside the gold, and in 28% of MMDocRAG questions a non-gold candidate alone supplies a required fact. Single-gold scoring then fails in three predictable ways. A retriever that finds a copy is scored as a miss: page recall@1 of text and visual retrievers is underestimated by 13-24 points on questions with a cross-page copy. A model that cites a copy is scored as citing wrongly: crediting equivalent evidence reverses 11% of pairwise orderings among 65 competitive MMDocRAG systems. Masking the gold region leaves the fact available elsewhere: with a copy in the input, 41-56% of correct answers across four models survive it yet fail once every annotated instance is masked. Set-level masking with automatically found copies closes 78% of the gap to masking every annotated instance at matched granularity (three models); an unverified key-string rule lowers survival at least as far but masks three times the area. We release the annotations and redundancy-aware metrics.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 MMLongBench-Doc 与 MMDocRAG 上标注 420 个问题中能独立支撑同一事实的全部位置，量化长视觉文档中跨页、跨模态的冗余证据，并展示单 gold 评估在检索召回、引用排序和遮挡实验上的三类系统性偏差，同时提出冗余感知指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及多模态推理中的证据筛选与评价：其遮挡实验显示有副本时模型答案在 gold 被遮挡后仍正确，与视觉旁路、视觉证据因果贡献的核查问题高度契合，冗余感知指标可供评估 LVR 证据归因。
